results.detail: Re-derived. The 'No CreateRow' condition of Check If Rejects Null ends with '&& JoiningStatus != 2', and only the 'Create Row' (default) output has a path to Create gen_fundEnrolment (component --list). The source selects 'gen_joiningstatus AS JoiningStatus' unqualified (DTSX:3364) and filters 'aj.gen_joiningstatus = 2' (DTSX:3417). The ownership argument is now written in the accepted form: aj.gen_lastsyncdate (DTSX:3361) and aj.gen_joiningstatus (DTSX:3417) appear qualified in the same query, and the other sources (tr, ac, and productByCourse with only num/gen_automatedjoining/ProductId) would make an unqualified duplicate ambiguous. So JoiningStatus is always 2, and the AND chain is always false. The result sentence is limited to joinings that are fetched and have no Fund Enrolment. The finding ends as an open question, not as a bug. A creation can still fail (catch at main.cs:282-291), but that is runtime-failure detail (plumbing).

results.detail: Create gen_fundEnrolment catches SoapException and Exception and routes the row to CastingError (main.cs:282-291). The pension Create Fund Enrolment catches Exception and routes it to CustingError (main.cs:330-334). Neither output has a path. In Update Reject Management With Fund Enrolment, the catch routes to Failure (main.cs:131-135), which goes to 'Derived Column' (DTSX:14623). That component has no input columns, no derived columns and no outgoing path. Re-fetch logic: the automated source has no Fund Enrolment condition (DTSX:3415-3417). Re-selection needs status 2 and the sync-date condition (ownership argued in the accepted form). A retry needs a Lookup no-match, and the Lookup matches any gen_fundenrolment with that gen_automatedjoining (DTSX:3614-3622). So a sibling transfer-request row that succeeded blocks the failed row in later runs. Pension: the link is written only on the Result path (Upate Pension Joining, DTSX:8056), and the source requires pj.gen_fundenrolmentid is null (DTSX:6934). Everything is stated conditionally.
